limitations: Single source seed20262020; Industrial1395/52 and RF100151/35 are previously viewed development populations. No new blind-test, statistical-significance, or single-factor causal claim.

V20 changes the deployed reading path and supervision relative to point readers. Equal source CNN exposure does not equal identical decoder/readout compute; saved wall timings are descriptive and include loading and process boundaries.

Source contracts, fresh initialization, input identity, GT isolation, and source-only BN behavior reuse saved preflight evidence. This audit loads no weights or RGB and executes no neural model, backward pass, optimizer, old GT audit, or test suite.
V12 local endpoint uses its saved768-input and four-epoch protocol; old GeoPRR is historical same-population context. Their executed pixels and weight provenance are not recertified here.
Saved masses are continuous diagnostics. Outside-arc mass is not a correctness criterion or new rejection gate; endpoint transport can retain high outside mass with a correct reading.
Loss checks use saved finite epoch aggregates and the declared FP32 decomposition. Training primary loss is not reconstructed from validation predictions; no missing gradient record is invented.

The complete remote raw source data_contract remains private on the server. The local collection contains only explicit scalar artifacts and sanitized run metadata; weights, source image paths, boxes, and geometry arrays are excluded.
